beats.care: These lakes supply your tap water next summer. Good monsoon rain now means fewer cuts later.
beats.what: Storage in the five lakes rose from 3,949 mcft on Oct 16 to 4,186 mcft on Oct 18, out of 11,757 mcft.
beats.why: Most rain fell on the city itself. Lakes fill more slowly, as water flows in from catchments.

watch: Lake levels should keep rising as heavy rain continues till about October 26.
